projects.name: Kafei
projects.desc: A coffee diary for iPhone. Log every cup, keep a map of your cafés, and let a quick “which is the better cup?” game rank them for you.
points: Snap a drink and on-device AI (Apple Vision) cuts out the background, so logging takes a photo instead of a form and inference costs stay low as it scales.
Head-to-head ranking: answer “which is the better cup?” and a custom algorithm sorts every café you've been to.
Map-based café discovery, monthly stats (cups, spend, caffeine) and a shareable report card.
Owned it end to end: user research, roadmap, specs, and the full UX and visual system in Figma.

projects.name: Twittergram
projects.desc: A social network that crosses Instagram with X: real-time tweets stream straight into an Instagram-style feed, with friends, posts and comments built around them.
points: Live posts from X streamed into the feed with Apache Kafka.
GPT-based pipelines that generate, rank and personalize content using social ranking signals.
Selfie → movie star: vector search in ChromaDB plus a face API matches your profile photo (stored on S3) to the IMDb actors you look most like.
Ranking algorithms on Apache Spark surface the posts and people most relevant to you.

points: Weekly recaps of what I did, ate, drank and learned.
Lifestyle content made for an audience back home in Taiwan.

projects.name: Gabee
projects.desc: A home-barista log for making coffee and collecting beans. Dial in every espresso shot, keep track of the beans you brew, and watch your daily caffeine without overdoing it.
points: Espresso dial-in: log dose, yield, grind and brew time and get instant feedback on whether a shot is on target, under or over extracted.
A running log of the beans you brew, from Ethiopia Yirgacheffe to Colombia Huila, with star ratings to remember your best shots.
Café drinks count too: caffeine is estimated automatically, and an animated iced cup fills up toward your 400mg daily limit, with alerts as you get close.
Full history grouped by day, behind secure sign-in with hashed passwords and JWT tokens.
